style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Ratnam Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: In rich shades of merlot, this set of four Ratnam baubles offers a warm, jewel-toned finish to festive styling. Their faceted, gem-like shape catches the light beautifully, with the antique glass finish along with simple gold clasp add classic character. Whether used to anchor your overall theme or as a finishing touch, their delicate scale and rich colour help create depth, balance, and visual rhythm across your tree, wreath, or tabletop display. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade character.
